data.name: SoundBoardDescription
data.value: ...an app where you can create and run your own custom sound board full of your favorite bytes, effects, and clips.

data.name: SoundBoardExplanation1
data.value: Sound Board is split into pages, so you can group your favorite sounds together. To get started, add your first sound page by clicking "add page" above!

data.name: SoundBoardExplanation2
data.value: To load a sound, just drag an audio file onto a button or click the three little dots to browse. Then click the button with the sound name on it to play it!

data.name: SoundBoardExplanation3
data.value: To find a sound in a hurry, just start typing its name and an instant search bar will appear!

data.name: SoundBoardExplanation4
data.value: Pages and sounds are saved, so when you're done, just close the app, and it'll pick up right where you left off next time!

data.name: SoundBoardExplanation5
data.value: Add, remove pages, or rename pages at any time by clicking buttons at the top. Feel free to remove this page when you're ready to go! Bring it back any time by clicking "help".

data.name: UpdateManifestNoFileHash
data.value: The update manifest does not contain a file hash for this download.
data.comment: One of the reasons an update can be rejected; shown inside UpdateVerificationFailed.

data.name: UpdateManifestEmptyFileHash
data.value: The update manifest contains an empty file hash for this download.
data.comment: One of the reasons an update can be rejected; shown inside UpdateVerificationFailed.

data.name: UpdateManifestWrongHashAlgorithm
data.value: The update manifest uses hash algorithm '{0}'; only {1} is accepted.
data.comment: {0} is the algorithm the manifest asked for, {1} the only one accepted (SHA256). Neither is translated.

data.name: UpdateManifestMalformedHash
data.value: The update manifest contains a malformed SHA-256 hash.
data.comment: One of the reasons an update can be rejected; shown inside UpdateVerificationFailed.

data.name: UpdateNoManifest
data.value: No update manifest is available to verify the download against.
data.comment: One of the reasons an update can be rejected; shown inside UpdateVerificationFailed.

data.name: UpdateHashMismatch
data.value: The downloaded file does not match the SHA-256 hash in the update manifest.
data.comment: One of the reasons an update can be rejected; shown inside UpdateVerificationFailed.

data.name: UpdateHashChangedBeforeApply
data.value: The downloaded update no longer matches its expected hash.
data.comment: The download passed verification but changed again before it could be applied.

data.name: UpdateCouldNotReplaceExecutable
data.comment: {0} is the underlying error, which comes from Windows and is not translated here.

data.name: UpdateReplacedExecutableHashMismatch
data.value: The executable was replaced but does not match the expected hash.

data.name: UpdateElevationCancelled
data.value: The update was cancelled at the elevation prompt.
data.comment: The user chose No on the Windows administrator prompt.

data.name: UpdateElevatedHelperStartFailed
data.value: Could not start the elevated updater: {0}
data.comment: {0} is the underlying error, which comes from Windows and is not translated here.

data.name: UpdateElevatedHelperNotStarted
data.value: Could not start the elevated updater.
data.comment: Same as UpdateElevatedHelperStartFailed but with no underlying error to report.

data.name: UpdateElevatedHelperFailed
data.value: The elevated updater failed (exit code {0}); see the log for details.
data.comment: {0} is the process exit code.
